resource_units.kbit_s: whole client non-loopback received bytes / scene seconds, decimal kbit/s; not bidirectional sum
resource_units.rss: midpoint process-name sums in KiB; not peak/session total
resource_units.cpu: transport process/thread scheduler percent of one core; source/observer Python excluded

limits: Raw transport RX/CPU counter endpoints and RSS samples are not separately saved: resource verification covers raw-result-to-summary-to-CSV identity and formula/unit source review, not independent counter remeasurement
No independent terminal emulation/full capture replay
Data validity and artifact isolation do not establish candidate acceptance or causal mechanism
Age is conditional on completed body frames, not input/held-screen/GPU latency
31 legacy completed-write source pipeline and32 RAM prewrite/signal source pipeline cannot be absolutely pooled
Legacy pending source writes are not recorded; do not infer zero pending in31
CPU30 is admission only; runtime CPU/process values are retained context; no P-core affinity proof
